description: 3-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 80% Area Median Income (AMI).  Maximum income for 3 people = $112,200; 4 = $124,700, 5= $134,650; 6= $144,650 etc. Must be 1st-time  homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community  Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on  DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, April 24, 2026.  Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program Info. Application, loan pre-approval, and  homebuyer education verification due on May 21, 2026 at 5:00 PM. April 25 @ 1-3 pm, April 26 @ 1-3 pm,  May 7 @5:30-7:30pm. Fair Housing Opportunity.
